WhatsApp: as of today, turning the MP4 into a sound sticker only works on Android with WhatsApp Beta, on accounts where Meta has enabled it (Stickers → Create → pick the video from the gallery). Sharing the MP4 into a chat sends it as a regular video.

To try it as a sound sticker: save it to the gallery, open a chat in WhatsApp Beta for Android → Stickers → Create (+) → pick this video. WhatsApp decides the final length and sound; the feature is rolling out gradually and is not officially documented.

Make 5 s or 10 s sound videos from a sticker and a sound. Everything is processed on your device: no accounts, no servers. The only network request is downloading a MyInstants link you paste or share.\n\nAndroid port of StikSound by SilverFeit, released under the MIT or Apache-2.0 license.
